description: This file defines the ColumnRange class, which manages ranges of columns in a spreadsheet, including methods for creation, shifting, and conversion to cell ranges within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: ColumnRange
classes.description: Represents a range of columns in a worksheet, providing utilities to manipulate and convert column ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ColumnRange object from starting and ending columns and an optional worksheet.

methods.name: fromColumnIndexes
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from integer column indexes.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from an array of column identifiers.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Validates and sets the start and end indexes for the column range.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns in the range.

methods.name: shiftDown
methods.description: Returns a new ColumnRange shifted down by a specified offset.

methods.name: shiftUp
methods.description: Returns a new ColumnRange shifted up by a specified offset.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the start column of the range as a string.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the end column of the range as a string.

methods.name: toCellRange
methods.description: Converts the column range to a CellRange object spanning all rows.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the column range, including worksheet name if available.
